propositions: infer_provider('gemini-2.5-pro') returns 'google_genai', which is not a member of _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders, causing provider construction to fail at call time with LLMConfigError.

A bare gemini-* model id configured via model_classes._resolve_target() composes a qualified provider string using the inferred but unresolvable 'google_genai' name, whereas the same id passed through anthropic_model._pai_model() accidentally survives due to a private translation table.

The fix maps gemini prefix to 'google' (pydantic-ai's canonical Gemini Developer API provider name, already registered in KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and _pydantic_ai_known_providers()) rather than 'google_genai', making bare gemini-* ids resolvable without reintroducing deprecated or v2.0-removed provider names.

An invariant test must pin that every value in _PROVIDER_PREFIXES maps to a provider name present in either _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders, preventing future prefixes from reintroducing unresolvable mappings.
Inference for claude-*, gpt-*/chatgpt-*, already-qualified ids, and unknown ids must remain unchanged and regression-pinned after the gemini mapping fix.
